Class WarMojo

All Implemented Interfaces:

@Mojo(name="war", defaultPhase=PACKAGE, threadSafe=true, requiresDependencyResolution=COMPILE_PLUS_RUNTIME) public class WarMojo extends AbstractWarMojo
Build a WAR file.
